• Style A (Harvest & Thanksgiving Set): Includes 30x Player Bingo Cards, 1x Callout Card, and 8x Marker Sheets (featuring festive Autumn, Harvest, and Thanksgiving themes).

results.title: Christmas Party Games Bundle | Printable Christmas Games | Christmas Bingo Game | Gift Exchange Game | Pin the Nose | Scavenger Hunt
results.description:
The tree is lit, the house is full, and dinner is done. Now comes the part of the night everyone actually remembers.

This bundle is the games plan for a family Christmas party at home: four real games in one matching storybook watercolor style, printed at home on US Letter paper, with a one-page run sheet that puts them in the right order. A hunt while guests arrive. A classic at full energy. The gift exchange, which is the moment the whole room leans in. And a calm game of bingo to land the night. You host the party, and you get to play it too.

Made for family Christmas parties, with games little kids, grandparents and everyone between can play together. The type is big and high-contrast on purpose. Two of the four games are played entirely sitting down. The youngest players need no reading at all: bingo and the hunt both work by matching pictures. No game needs speed, standing, or small careful hands to be enjoyed.

WHAT'S INCLUDED: 4 GAMES PLUS A RUN SHEET

- Christmas Bingo. 10 different bingo cards plus 27 calling cards, all with Christmas pictures and the name under every picture, so little players match by sight and nobody is left out. Pictures, not numbers. Cover a whole row and shout BINGO! 12 pages.
- Pin the Nose on the Reindeer. A poster at 8.5 x 11 in, plus a big tiled poster at 16.5 x 21.5 in (4 pages to tape together), and 8 shiny red noses with a name patch on each one. The kids' highlight of the night. 6 pages.
- Christmas Scavenger Hunt. A 5 x 7 in checklist card with 10 finds, plus two pages of printable treasures to cut out and hide around the house before guests arrive: a red ornament, a gold star, a candy cane, a gold bell, a snowflake, a gingerbread man and a Christmas gift. The last 3 finds are already at any Christmas party. 3 pages.
- The Left-Right Gift Exchange. A fun alternative to Secret Santa. Every guest brings one wrapped gift, nobody draws names, and an original story written for this game does all the swapping: pass left, pass right, and the gift in your hands at the end is yours. A setup card with a fill-in line for your gift limit, plus the story in big, comfortable print for whoever reads it aloud. 3 pages.
- How to Run the Games. A one-page run sheet for the host: the order to play the games and why, what each game needs, how to hide the hunt treasures, and the photo moment to catch. 1 page.

All together: 5 PDF files, 25 print pages.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Download. Your files are ready right after checkout, here on Etsy.
2. Print. Print at home at 100% size. Almost everything prints on US Letter paper; the hunt checklist card is 5 x 7 in.
3. Cut. Scissors are all you need: calling cards, noses and treasures.
4. Play. Follow the run sheet: hunt first, noses next, the gift exchange, then bingo to finish.

PAPER, IN PLAIN WORDS

- Heavyweight home printer paper (28 to 32 lb) works well for the hunt card, the calling cards and the treasures. No print shop needed.
- Cardstock is the better pick for the bingo cards, the poster and the noses, so they stand up to a whole party.

A NOTE ON DECOR

This bundle is games only: no invitations, banners or table decor in this download. It is the playing part of the party, ready to drop into whatever you have already planned. Find more printable party kits and games in the Happy Houseparty shop.

QUESTIONS

Q: Is anything mailed to me?
A: No. This is a digital download, so nothing physical ships. Paper, ink, and everyday bits like coins, tape and a scarf for a blindfold are not included. You get the files listed above, ready to print at home.

Q: How does the gift exchange work?
A: Every guest brings one wrapped gift at a limit the host sets, with no name tag on it. Everyone sits in a circle holding a gift while the host reads the included story aloud. Every time the story says LEFT, all gifts pass left; every time it says RIGHT, they pass right. When the story ends, the gift in your hands is yours to open and keep. No names are drawn and nobody has to shop for a specific person, which is why hosts use it as a fun alternative to Secret Santa.

Q: What ages is this for?
A: The whole family, on purpose. Little kids play bingo and the hunt by matching pictures, with no reading needed. The gift exchange and bingo are played sitting down, the print is big and high-contrast for grandparents, and pin the nose is the one game that gets everybody up and laughing. Nothing needs speed or standing to be enjoyed.

Q: What else do we need to play?
A: Very little, and it is all ordinary household stuff: coins, buttons or crayons for bingo markers, a bowl or a hat for the calling cards, tape or a pin for the noses, a scarf or sleep mask for a blindfold, and one wrapped gift per guest for the exchange. The run sheet lists it game by game.

Q: How many people can play?
A: Bingo has 10 different cards and there are 8 noses, one per player. For a bigger group, print the noses page again and print a checklist card for every hunter. The gift exchange works with as many guests as you can fit in a circle.

Q: What size is everything?
A: Bingo cards and calling cards print on US Letter. The reindeer poster comes at 8.5 x 11 in and as a big tiled poster at 16.5 x 21.5 in. The hunt checklist card is 5 x 7 in. The gift exchange setup card and story print on US Letter.
